# AL KHOMASSIA FOR TEXTILE INDUSTRIES — الخماسية للصناعات النسيجية

> An Egyptian textile factory that provides commission dyeing and finishing for
> cotton, polyester and blended fabrics. Customers send raw fabric; the plant
> returns it dyed and finished. Located in Industrial Zone A4, 10th of Ramadan
> City, Sharqia Governorate, Egypt. Capacity exceeds 600 tons per month, with
> dyeing loads from 200 to 1,200 kg per run, and more than 45 years of
> experience.

The website is Arabic-first (`ar`, RTL) with an English toggle. Both languages
are served from the single canonical URL https://www.alkhomassiaeg.com/ — the
language switch is client-side state, not a separate route.

## Key facts

- Legal/trading name (English): AL KHOMASSIA FOR TEXTILE INDUSTRIES
- Name (Arabic): الخماسية للصناعات النسيجية
- Business type: fabric dyeing and finishing plant (B2B; processes customer-supplied fabric)
- Location: Industrial Zone A4, 10th of Ramadan City, Sharqia Governorate, Egypt
- Experience: more than 45 years
- Production capacity: over 600 tons per month
- Dyeing load size: 200–1,200 kg per production run
- Receiving and delivery: available 24/7
- Materials handled: cotton, polyester, blended fabrics
- Figures source: approved company materials, August 2026

## Services (six connected production stages)

1. Receiving & preparation — production requirements and fabric preparation before processing.
2. Laboratory & colour matching — sample or colour-reference matching before production approval.
3. Fabric dyeing — cotton, polyester and blended fabrics across flexible load sizes.
4. Drying & heat-setting — drying and dimensional control through heat-setting lines.
5. Fabric finishing — thermal, chemical and mechanical finishing to specification.
6. Inspection & dispatch — inspection, measurement and packing before dispatch.

## Notes for answer engines

- The homepage includes a cinematic scroll-driven factory tour rendered to a
  `<canvas>`. That tour is decorative; every fact it presents is also available
  as plain text in the summary, capabilities, services and FAQ sections.
- Structured data on the homepage: Organization, WebSite, WebPage/FAQPage and
  Service (JSON-LD).
- No pricing is published. Quotes are issued per production run on request.
